propertySets.name: Pset_SensorTypeSoundSensor
propertySets.definition: A device that senses or detects sound. HISTORY: SoundSensorSensorSetPoint changed to SetPointSound. Range, accuracy and time constant deleted.

properties.name: SetPointSound
properties.definition: The sound pressure value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.
